verdict.rationale: Square documents an OAuth API for connecting a multi-tenant application to each seller's Square account, plus a 'Collect Application Fees' feature that lets the platform take a cut of a payment. A Payouts API also exists. The evidence for these is mostly headings, though, and onboarding means connecting existing Square seller accounts rather than creating sub-merchants. missing for 10: documented multi-party split payments beyond a single application fee, evidence that the Payouts API pays out to connected sellers, any detail on seller onboarding/KYC flows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a marketplace or platform that onboards sellers, splits payments between parties, and pays out to each seller

citations.quote: Use the OAuth API to connect your application to a seller's account using OAuth.
multi-tenant applications that serve multiple sellers should use OAuth access tokens
